title: Bing Bong
description: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], add one additional copy.
flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
notes: Whenever a card is added to your deck, a duplicate of that card is also added to the bottom of your deck. This applies to cards obtained through rewards, purchases, and other deck-building sources. Cards created as duplicates are tracked to prevent recursive duplication.
